title: 4/04 confirmed pick never locked: a projected batter from a postponed game held the early-lock gap open
tier_reason: the day's confirmed pick never locked (posted) through the scheduler's lock path (delivery impact); whether and when it was delivered by another path (post-loop fallback or by hand) is not evidenced

contract.text: A confirmed-lineup pick locks (is posted) once its gap over the best projected-lineup alternative from a still-pickable game reaches early_lock_gap.

mechanism.text: run_single_check built the should_lock comparison set from every prediction row regardless of game status, so a projected batter in the postponed CHC@CLE game stayed within 3% of the confirmed pick and should_lock returned False at every check

residual.text: an unlocked pick's only backstop was the post-loop fallback (run_day step 5), which ran after the last scheduled check, possibly after the pick's first pitch; the in-loop fallback arrived on 4/06 (0632976, I-013)
no alert fired for a pick still unlocked near first pitch; detection was the operator's. All in-process protections still share the scheduler's fate: there is no independent day-outcome watchdog

watchdog.trigger: at the earliest pick game's first pitch minus 5 minutes, a candidate pick exists with no delivery record and no recorded deliberate skip
watchdog.recovery_assertion: an alert is delivered and the date ends with a delivered, scoreable pick or an explicit operator pass

evidence.what: should_lock considered projected batters from all games (postponed, started, finished); this 'caused today's pick (Díaz) to never lock' because a projected batter (Kwan) from the postponed CHC@CLE game was within 3% of the confirmed pick
four scheduler changes 'from today's debugging session': short-circuit when the pick is locked, logging of each should_lock decision, and a pick audit trail in runs_completed
the lock path posts only when should_lock is True; the only other delivery path was the step-5 fallback after the last scheduled check
any function comparing against projected picks must exclude non-Preview games
